import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Amount distribution by transaction type
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# 2. Transaction count by type
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set2', len(transaction_counts)))
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count')

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
axes[1, 0].scatter(data['hour_of_day'], data['amount'], 
                   c=data['transaction_type'].astype('category').cat.codes, 
                   cmap='Set2', s=200, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add legend for transaction types
handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', 
                      markerfacecolor=sns.color_palette('Set2')[i], 
                      markersize=10, label=tt) 
          for i, tt in enumerate(data['transaction_type'].unique())]
axes[1, 0].legend(handles=handles, title='Transaction Type')

# 4. Fraud status pie chart
fraud_counts = data['is_fraud'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
labels = ['Legitimate', 'Fraud']
axes[1, 1].pie(fraud_counts.values, labels=[labels[i] for i in fraud_counts.index], 
               autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fraud vs Legitimate Transactions')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
